title: Role → its name and identifier (kg-export and glossary-export alike)
description: How a declared role is NAMED, by every generator that mints its IRI, makeIri(doc, "role", id). One table for both, so the merged graph carries one label per role node (finding D3 of docs/proposals/vocabulary-mappings-2026-10-02.md, bean lodp). Before it, kg-export wrote dcterms:title plus rdfs:label = the id and glossary-export wrote skos:prefLabel plus skos:notation = the id, so one node had rdfs:label "reviewer" and skos:prefLabel "Reviewer", and skos:prefLabel is a sub-property of rdfs:label. Owner default applied, option 1, 2026-10-02 (asked, no answer, the stated default holds), following bean sl9u: the display name is skos:prefLabel AND dcterms:title, the id is skos:notation, and the id is no longer a label. skos:prefLabel is authoritative; dcterms:title is its rendering for resource-metadata readers, declared derived so it is COPIED and cannot drift.

target.comment: vocabulary-authority: skos:prefLabel is the fact, dcterms:title its derived copy (bean sl9u, applied to roles by D3).
The id is a code, not a label. kg-export wrote it as rdfs:label until D3; it no longer does.

element.display: Deliberately NOT rdfs:label: a second label beside skos:prefLabel, carrying a different string, is the D3 conflict this table removes.
